snippet.title: MagFighter - We’re Going FREE TO PLAY – End of April 2026 🔥
snippet.description:
The fight is just getting started.
At the end of April 2026, the game goes FREE TO PLAY.

New players. New chaos. Same brutal action.
Jump in now — or wait for the flood.

Physics based multiplayer chaos. 2d Pixel art and weird and whacky spell interactions.
